# 2026-07-15 AI Weekly

*Auto-generated by news-agent. Expires in 7 days.*

## Models & releases

- **Claude Sonnet 4.6** — Anthropic shipped an updated Sonnet with improved coding and instruction-following. [Release notes](https://anthropic.com)
- **Gemini 2.5 Pro** — Google extended context to 2M tokens; strong on long-document reasoning benchmarks.
- **Mistral Medium 3** — Competitive at mid-tier pricing; French team continues to close the gap.

## Research

- *"Constitutional AI at Scale"* — Anthropic paper on applying CAI principles to model families rather than individual checkpoints. Key finding: preference data quality matters more than quantity beyond a threshold.
- *"Attention is All You Need"* hits 10K citations — retro thread on what the transformer paper got right, what it missed, and what has changed.

## Tooling

- **Cursor 1.0** — out of beta. Adds multi-file diff review, background agents, and a Claude connector.
- **MCP ecosystem** — 200+ registered MCP servers now in the Claude directory. Relay appeared in a community roundup of self-hostable servers.

## Observations

Context windows are effectively unlimited for most tasks; the bottleneck has shifted to retrieval quality and cost-per-token at inference time. Architectures that keep the knowledge base close to the model (relay-style: file-based, queryable, MCP-accessible) are looking more relevant, not less.
